description: This source file implements core diff functionalities for a version control system, including regex-based searching in diffs, handling of text conversions, and pickaxe algorithms for change detection.

methods.name: int diffgrep_consume(void * priv,char * line,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Consumes lines from diff output to check for a regex match, marking when a match occurs.

methods.name: int diff_grep(mmfile_t * one,mmfile_t * two,struct diff_options * o,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws UNUSED)
methods.description: Performs a diff-based regex search to determine if a pattern appears in added or deleted lines.

methods.name: unsigned int contains(mmfile_t * mf,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws,unsigned int limit)
methods.description: Checks if a mmfile_t buffer contains matches of a regex or string pattern up to a specified limit.

methods.name: int has_changes(mmfile_t * one,mmfile_t * two,struct diff_options * o UNUSED,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws)
methods.description: Determines whether two mmfile_t buffers differ based on the presence of matches.

methods.name: int pickaxe_match(struct diff_filepair * p,struct diff_options * o,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws,pickaxe_fn fn)
methods.description: Checks if a diff filepair matches a pickaxe pattern using a specified matching function.

methods.name: void pickaxe(struct diff_queue_struct * q,struct diff_options * o,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws,pickaxe_fn fn)
methods.description: Filters a diff queue based on pickaxe pattern matching, either showing all or only matching filepairs.

methods.name: void regcomp_or_die(regex_t * regex,const char * needle,int cflags)
methods.description: Compiles a regex pattern or terminates the program if compilation fails.

methods.name: void diffcore_pickaxe(struct diff_options * o)
methods.description: Main function to perform pickaxe-based diff filtering based on regex or string matching options.
